doc.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Music heard at home growing up
summary: She heard Billie Holiday, Dinah Washington, Basie and Ellington at home; both parents loved music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: What are your earliest recollections of hearing music in your household? And what styles . . .

I heard Billie Holiday. I heard Dinah Washington. I heard Count Basie. I heard, oh, good lord, I heard all the best; everything that was good, I heard. Duke Ellington; I mean, I was surrounded by the best. I mean, I heard all the good stuff, all the goodies.
Did both of your parents have an interest in music?
